title: Synthetic benchmark hull fixture
description: Documents the shape of tests/fixtures/synthetic/*.json's "hull" object and tests/local_fixtures/*.generated.json (see tools/build_local_benchmarks.py). Not enforced by a runtime JSON-Schema validator -- this project has no such dependency -- kept as a human/tooling-readable contract so the two fixture sources (hand-authored synthetic, locally-extracted real) stay structurally compatible. Field names and meaning mirror core/models.py's Hull dataclass exactly; add a field here only when you add it there.

weapon_mounts.description: Each entry mirrors a real weaponSlots entry: at minimum id/type/size. type is one of BALLISTIC/ENERGY/MISSILE/HYBRID/COMPOSITE/SYNERGY/UNIVERSAL/LAUNCH_BAY (see core/mount_compatibility.py for the weapon-compatibility matrix these feed).
